Make the test_dummy_encryption mount option require that the encrypt
feature flag be already enabled on the filesystem
automatically enabling it.  Practically
will need to be included in MKFS_OPTIONS when running xfstests with the
test_dummy_encryption mount option.  (ext4/053 also needs an update.)
Moreover
column2: as long as the preconditions for test_dummy_encryption are

column1: being tightened anyway
column2: take the opportunity to start rejecting it when

column1: !CONFIG_FS_ENCRYPTION rather than ignoring it.
The motivation for requiring the encrypt feature flag is that:
- Having the filesystem auto-enable feature flags is problematic
bypasses the usual sanity checks.  The specific issue which came up
recently is that in kernel versions where ext4 supports casefold but
not encrypt+casefold (v5.1 through v5.10)
the encrypt flag to a filesystem that has the casefold flag
unmountable -- but only for subsequent mounts
This confused the casefold support detection in xfstests
generic/556 to fail rather than be skipped.
- The xfstests-bld test runners (kvm-xfstests et al.) already use the
required mkfs flag
column2: so they will not be affected by this change.  Only

column1: users of test_dummy_encryption alone will be affected.  But
option has always been for testing only
column2: so it should be fine to

column1: require that the few users of this option update their test scripts.
- f2fs already requires it (for its equivalent feature flag).
